cover_headline: Jailer 2 Crosses ₹209 Crore Worldwide in Two Days, Eyes a Record Weekend

end.headline: Jailer 2 Crosses ₹209 Crore Worldwide in Two Days, Eyes a Record Weekend
end.line: A 38% day-two drop counts as a phenomenal hold for a Rajinikanth opener — with Dussehra holidays ahead, trade trackers say ₹500 crore by midweek is in play.

facts: Jailer 2 grossed about ₹84 crore worldwide on day two, taking its two-day worldwide total to roughly ₹209 crore
India gross reached ₹108 crore in two days — a 38% day-two drop that counts as a phenomenal hold for a Rajinikanth opener
Nearly half the worldwide gross so far has come from outside India, powered by the North America premiere run and packed shows in the Gulf and Southeast Asia
